# cli-appendix-job-outline

Purpose: Plan headless blender --background export or render jobs when MCP chat control is a poor fit; cite upstream Blender CLI docs only.

Structure **CLI fallback appendix** jobs (batch render, batch export, scripted scene setup) using Blender's documented command-line interface — without presenting arbitrary Python as the user-facing product surface.

Metadata: Contract `v1.0.0` | Category `runtime-and-execution` | Role `headless-cli-batch-job-planner` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- CI / render farm / repeatable exports
- MCP unavailable or disallowed by policy
- deterministic batch operations vs exploratory modeling
- Trigger phrases: "headless blender", "batch render CLI", "blender --background", "render farm outline"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- interactive viewport iteration primary goal → use `runtime-path-picker` (`references/skill-runtime-path-picker.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to runtime-path-picker)
- user expects Connector chat loop → use `path-one-host-outline` (`references/skill-path-one-host-outline.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to path-one-host-outline)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `target_blend_scene_and_outputs` (`object`): Source .blend file expectations and target render/export output deliverables
- Required input `execution_environment_constraints` (`string`): Headless CI, render node, or local batch constraints selected via runtime-path-picker
- Optional input `frame_range_or_batch_items` (`array`): Optional frame range or batch variant list for headless execution
- Output contract: `headless_cli_job_outline`, `appendix_governance_and_backup_gates`, `expected_output_evidence_hooks` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. classify job type via `skills/cli-appendix-job-outline/references/job-type-matrix.md`
2. capture ordering cautions `skills/cli-appendix-job-outline/references/flag-order-reminders.md`
3. state limitations `skills/cli-appendix-job-outline/references/stateless-limitations.md`
4. point user to upstream CLI manual for exact flags

## Cross-skill handoffs
- [upstream_reference] Pick MCP vs CLI → `runtime-path-picker` (`references/skill-runtime-path-picker.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.path equals "unselected"]`
- [upstream_reference] Interactive MCP host outline → `path-one-host-outline` (`references/skill-path-one-host-outline.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.path equals "path_1"; stage.current equals "runtime_setup"]`
- [progression] Export format choices → `output-format-decision` (`references/skill-output-format-decision.md`) — `when.all: [decision.formatLocked equals false]`
- [progression] Actual CLI output evidence recording → `render-export-evidence` (`references/skill-render-export-evidence.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "post_execution_audit"]`
- [progression] Runtime attempt reporting → `runtime-attempt-report-writer` (`references/skill-runtime-attempt-report-writer.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.status in ["Attempted","Produced","Verified","Failed"]; request.topic equals "attempt_report"]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Planning outline only — BlendOps never executes Blender and never presents arbitrary Python as the product surface. This CLI workflow is an **appendix only**, never a peer path without an eval record, and BlendOps has **no in-repo CLI evidence file yet**. Point users to the upstream Blender manual for exact CLI flags.
- Generating or debugging user-facing Python (`bpy`) scripts.
- Executing `blender --background` jobs or inspecting output files directly.
- Selecting between MCP Path 1, Path 2, and CLI (owned by `runtime-path-picker`).
- Certifying rendered frames or exported GLBs (owned by `render-export-evidence`).
